in_greek.name: Παύλα
in_greek.long_meaning: derived from the Greek root παύο (pauo) meaning 'I have inflicted' or 'I have stopped' and λαός (laos) meaning 'the people'; Paula is a feminine form of the name Paul, which is derived from the same Greek root. The name Pavla may also be considered a diminutive form of Paula, meaning 'little Paul'

in_latin.name: Paula
in_latin.long_meaning: derived from the Latin name Paulus, which is a cognate of the Greek name Paul. Paulus is derived from the Latin word paulus, meaning 'small' or 'humble'
